issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite conventions requiring tests for every feature, including authorization paths.

conventions.evidence: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:1-38 policies for authorization; database/migrations/2026_10_29_073911_create_entities_table.php:30-33 and 2026_10_29_073912_create_entity_memberships_table.php:70-73 reversible down(); app/Models/Entity.php:43 fillable name,slug and app/Models/EntityMembership.php:104 fillable entity_id,user_id,role; CHANGELOG.md:9 and docs/database-schema.md:483-534 docs kept in sync

readability.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:45-76 small focused relations with PHPDoc; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:281-307 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:239-263 clear names, consistent style, no dead code

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_073911_create_entities_table.php:418-424 entities_slug_unique, timestamps, softDeletes; database/migrations/2026_10_29_073912_create_entity_memberships_table.php:456-464 cascade FKs, role default employee, entity_memberships_entity_user_unique, owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner; app/Models/UserRole.php:7-21 manageable returns [Admin,Employee]; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:281-307 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:239-263 match all authorization rules; factories and owner() scope cover contract

scope.evidence: change.diff:1-536 only CHANGELOG.md, app/Models/*, app/Policies/*, database/factories/*, database/migrations/*, docs/database-schema.md — all serve the entity data-model task, no routes/pages/session or unrelated features

security.evidence: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:286-307 view/update/delete/manageSettings check membershipFor and Owner/Admin roles; app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:239-263 view/assignRole/delete enforce membership and block owner deletion with self-removal; app/Models/Entity.php:43 and EntityMembership.php:104 fillable excludes owner_seq/id, no unescaped output

simplicity.evidence: app/Models/User.php:192-195 membershipFor as one-line Eloquent query; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:299-302 delete reuses update(); no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/* or *Test.php files; no coverage of entities, memberships, single-owner constraint, or unauthorized-call paths

review.summary: Implements the full entity data model, single-owner DB constraint, models, enum, factories and policies per contract with clean scope. Missing any Pest/PHPUnit tests violates the test-first convention, so it needs tests before merging.
